note: Lolo National Forest campground and picnic area on US-12 ~15 mi west of Lolo, forested and beside Lolo Creek at ~3,800 ft; interpretive site, Lewis and Clark/Nez Perce trail nearby, Lolo Pass Visitor Center 19 mi west. --Claude
summary: Confirmed FCFS/no reservations, 30-ft parking spurs, vault toilets, $15/night. Added potable water, season 05-15 to 09-08 (2026; closed 9/21 in practice). Not stated on the page: site count 17 and no hookups (derived left). Note trimmed of restated values.
